dimensions.expression: iif(customers.id is not null and sum(amount, partition_by=customers.id) > 2000, 'high', 'other')
dimensions.name: segment

dimensions.expression: iif(customer_id is not null and sum(amount, partition_by=customer_id) > 2000, 'high', 'other')
dimensions.name: segment

args.message: Revenue is sum(orders.amount) over all orders. A customer is high-spend if the total of all their orders is above 2000. Orders with no matched customer fall under 'other'. High-spend: 194,165.78 (2,879 orders). Other: 138,522.67 (2,137 orders).
